title: Kereya Neeranu - Malahari - Tisra Triputa - Purandaradasa
name: Kereya Neeranu

ragas.name: Malahari
ragas.was: Malahari - S’ D1 P M1 G2 R1 S

parts.title: Pallavi
text: In this geetham, Purandaradasa describes the attributes of the devotees of the god Hari.
Look! The followers of Hari scoop water from the lake and pour it back into the lake while worshipping, with the intention of obtaining boons from the god.
In a similar manner, the life given as a considerate bequest by Hari is surrendered back to him.

parts.title: Charanam
text: These holy men spend their lives feasting their eyes on the lotus feet of the god who is the master of Purandara dasa.

words.title: Pallavi
lyric: kereya neeranu kerege jalli varava paDedava ranti kanero!
hariya karuNadoLaada BhAgyava hari samaarpane maaDi bradukero
text: The followers of Hari scoop water (“neeranu”) from the lake (“kere”) and pour (“jalli”) it back into the lake (“kere ge”) while worshipping, with the intention of obtaining boons (“varava padeda rante”) from the god. Look (“kanero”)!
In a similar manner, the life given as a considerate bequest (“karunadoLaada bhagyavu”) by Hari (“hari ya”) is (“maadi”) surrendered back to him (“hari samarpana”).

words.title: Charanam
lyric: Sree purandara viThala rAyA charaNa kamalava nodi bradukero
text: These holy men spend their lives (“bradukeru”) feasting their eyes (“nodi”) on the lotus feet (“charaNa kamalava”) of the god who is the master of Purandara dasa (sri purandara viThala rAyA). The life given as a considerate bequest (“karuNadolaada bhagyavu”) by Hari (“hari ya”) is (“maadi”) surrendered back to him (“hari samarpana”).
